composition_label: Ticket triage & routing -> Semantic search -> Behavioral personalization

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version, fixture_label, timezone-aware as_of, ticket {id,text}, catalog [{id,title,description,category,popularity}], events [{product_id,action,timestamp}], optional config
shared_schema.output: One envelope: schema_version, status, normalized request, triage, semantic, behavior. Errors: {status:error,error:message}, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One Validator validates input, numeric bounds, known product references, unique catalog ids, injected vector shape, timezone and non-future history, and every stage boundary. Unknown input/config fields rejected.
shared_schema.config: routes [{category,keywords,priority,team}], default_route {category,priority,team}, search_limit and final_limit (1..1000), half_life_days (0.000001..1000000), behavior_weight and cold_start_weight (0..100). Popularity is 0..1. Priorities: low, normal, high, urgent.

cross_stage_handoffs: Triage validates input, selects category/priority/accountable_team, and preserves ticket_id and query in a validated envelope.
Semantic consumes validated triage: query builds retrieval scores; routed category adds a relevance boost; ticket and category provenance are preserved.
Behavior consumes only validated semantic candidates, preserves their semantic scores, reranks with history, and propagates ticket, priority and accountable team.

behavior.triage: Casefolded Unicode token-set keyword matching; all keyword tokens must occur in ticket. Most keyword hits wins; configured order breaks ties. Zero matches uses default route.
behavior.semantic: In-memory inverted token index; lexical Jaccard relevance. Optional injected embed(list[str])->list[list[number]] uses 0.5 lexical + 0.5 nonnegative cosine. Category match adds 0.2. All catalog products are eligible including zero-score fallback; descending score then product id, truncated to search_limit.
behavior.personalization: Per-product evidence sums browse=1 and purchase=3, decayed by 2^(-age_days/half_life_days). Bonus=behavior_weight*evidence/(1+evidence). Empty history uses cold_start_weight*popularity. Final score=semantic+bonus. Sort descending then product id; truncate final_limit.
behavior.determinism: Explicit as_of; no wall-clock dependence or randomness. Scores rounded to ten decimal places. No request mutation. Empty catalog returns empty recommendations.
behavior.fixtures: All example records and callable embedding fixtures are explicitly synthetic. Embedding injection exists only as a Python library parameter; CLI never loads providers.

included: Lexical index and optional injected embedding similarity

test_outcomes.cli_stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok
coverage: CLI success, file errors, argument errors and malformed JSON
